aarti.tek: This is the āratī of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Kanhaiyā.
aarti.pad1: The āratī of him who came down as an avatāra in the prison of Mathurā, who played in Yaśodā's lap in Gokula: Nanda's darling, the finest of dancers, the holder of the mountain, Vāsudeva, the brother of Haladhara (Balarāma). ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: The āratī of him whom the peacock-feather crown and the yellow silk become, with the kāchanī (a short dhoti tucked up) at his waist and the flute shining in his hand; at the sight of whose face the full autumn moon is put to shame; whose beauty surpasses that of millions of Kāmas. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: The āratī of him who delights in the joyous rāsa with the gopīs; the destroyer of the Kauravas, Kāliya and Kaṃsa; who gives light to the moon, the sun and fire; who dwells in the hearts of all beings. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: The āratī of him who somewhere rides into battle and somewhere runs away, somewhere makes kings and somewhere grazes cows, somewhere is the Lord whose glory the Vedas sing; who makes the world dance and dances in Braj. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: The āratī of him who is without attributes and with them, and takes a body for his play; who made known the matchless wisdom of the Gītā; of Dāmodara, to whom I give myself in every way; the protector of brāhmaṇas, cows and gods. ॥5॥
